fields.description:
## Context / Problem

`infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh` writes the BuildKit cache cap into `/etc/docker/daemon.json` under `builder.gc`. It picks the key from the BuildKit version: `maxUsedSpace` directly under `gc` at BuildKit >= 0.13 (`gc_schema_for`, `DOCKER_MODERN_GC_BUILDKIT_MAJOR/MINOR` at lines 89-90), otherwise `defaultKeepStorage`. The daemon ignores the modern key on every Engine version, so any host that crossed the boundary would carry a cap that reads as installed but does not exist. Production (rebar-gerrit: Engine 25.0.16, BuildKit 0.12.6) takes the `defaultKeepStorage` branch and is unaffected today.

Evidence (primary sources; full citations in this ticket's root-cause comment):
- dockerd, not BuildKit, parses `builder.gc`. moby `daemon/config/builder.go` `BuilderGCConfig` at v25.0.0 through v27.5.1 has only `Enabled`, `Policy` and `DefaultKeepStorage`. v28.0.0 adds `DefaultReservedSpace`/`DefaultMaxUsedSpace`/`DefaultMinFreeSpace`. `MaxUsedSpace` exists only on `BuilderGCRule` (a `policy[]` entry), so a gc-level `maxUsedSpace` is dropped on every Engine.
- moby `daemon/config/config.go` v28.0.0 lists `builder` in `skipValidateOptions`, so `dockerd --validate` (script line 457) cannot flag the ignored key.
- BuildKit v0.17.0 release notes are the first to add reserved/max storage limits (#5359, #5079). v0.13.0-v0.16.0 notes have none. The Engine/BuildKit pairing (moby vendor.mod: 27.4.0 ships 0.17.3, 27.5.1 ships 0.18.2) means no BuildKit cutoff matches what the daemon parses.
- `defaultKeepStorage` is read by every Engine from 25.0 through moby master. On Engine 28 it maps to `DefaultReservedSpace` (builder.go v28.0.0 UnmarshalJSON). With max-used and min-free unset, BuildKit v0.20.0 `cache/manager.go` `calculateKeepBytes` returns `max(0, reserved)`, so it is still enforced as the ceiling.

## Approach

Write one key on every host: `builder.gc.defaultKeepStorage`. The version cutoff has been wrong twice (Engine >= 25.0 in bug 3057, now BuildKit >= 0.13). The one key that every supported Engine reads removes the guess altogether. A future removal of the deprecated alias is caught by the existing read-back (`effective_gc_verdict`) and the `docker_buildkit_gc_enforced` alarm.

In `infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh`:
- Delete `DOCKER_MODERN_GC_BUILDKIT_MAJOR/MINOR`, `probe_buildkit_version`, `gc_schema_for`, the `--buildkit-version` flag (an unknown argument then dies through the existing `*) die` arm), and the probe/warn block at lines 412-418.
- `render_daemon_json` always sets `gc["defaultKeepStorage"]` and pops `maxUsedSpace` plus the Engine 28 gc-level `defaultReservedSpace`, `defaultMaxUsedSpace` and `defaultMinFreeSpace`. A leftover `defaultReservedSpace` would override `defaultKeepStorage` on Engine 28 (builder.go v28.0.0 UnmarshalJSON only falls back when it is empty), and a leftover `defaultMaxUsedSpace` would raise the ceiling. Popping them keeps the share the only ceiling and removes a stale `maxUsedSpace` written by the old modern branch.
- Replace the `${schema}` wording in the warn messages with fixed text, and rewrite the header section "The rendered key depends on BuildKit version" and the mismatch warning (line 259) to state the dockerd-parses-it finding.

In `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` §"The BuildKit cap is not taking effect": replace the BuildKit-version paragraph with the single-key behaviour.

Out of scope: `infra/terraform/monitoring_autodeploy.tf`'s alarm description. Editing it creates a Terraform diff that only an apply clears, and production is read-only in this work. The buildx >= 0.18 read-back labels are bug flavoured-peridot-ankole, which follows this change.

## Scope

- `infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh` — drop the version branch, single key, stale-key cleanup, comments/messages.
- `tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py` — replace the version-boundary tests.
- `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` — runbook paragraph.

## Testing

Written first, failing on the current tree, in `tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py` (stubs on PATH, no autouse fixtures):
- `--print-json` with the stub reporting BuildKit 0.12.6, 0.13.2, 0.17.3, 0.20.0 and an unreadable version: every case renders `defaultKeepStorage` = 5 GiB and no `maxUsedSpace`. On the current tree, 0.13.2 and later render `maxUsedSpace`, and the unreadable case renders `maxUsedSpace`.
- An existing daemon.json carrying `maxUsedSpace`, `defaultReservedSpace`, `defaultMaxUsedSpace` and `defaultMinFreeSpace` under `builder.gc`: the render drops all four and keeps sibling keys.
- `--print-json` never calls `docker buildx inspect` (no version probe).
- `--buildkit-version` is rejected as an unknown argument (non-zero exit).
- `--check-gc-enforced` 1/0/unreadable cases keep passing unchanged.
- Production shape: Engine 25.0.16 / BuildKit 0.12.6 stub renders byte-identical output to the pre-change script.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `bash infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh --print-json` renders `builder.gc.defaultKeepStorage` = `"5368709120"` and no `maxUsedSpace`, `defaultReservedSpace`, `defaultMaxUsedSpace` or `defaultMinFreeSpace`, whatever BuildKit version the stub reports. Verified by the parametrized tests in `tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py`.
- [ ] For the production shape (Engine 25.0.16, BuildKit 0.12.6, empty daemon.json), `--print-json` output is byte-identical before and after the change. Verified by running the old and new script against the same stub and comparing with `diff`.
- [ ] `grep -n 'buildkit-version\|DOCKER_MODERN_GC\|gc_schema_for\|probe_buildkit_version' infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh` prints nothing.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/pytest tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py` passes. `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0, with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH. `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0.
- [ ] The change lands on `main` through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
